_readme: RESIDENT DIALOGUE — the survivors still holed up behind locked doors (scripts/resident_npc.gd).
Edit freely: every list is a pool, one line is picked at random each time (never the same line twice in a row).
Add as many lines as you like; an empty list just means that moment stays silent.
Three tempers: SCARED (wants you gone, runs from you, begs), HOSTILE (armed, squares up, warns once then attacks),
TRADER (wary, but offers a swap when you start going through their things).
Placeholders, filled in by the game: {give} = what the resident offers you, {get} = what they want from your pack.
Keep lines short — they show in a speech bubble over the resident's head (about 60 characters reads best).
'listen' = what you hear through the door when you listen at it (one line per temper).

enter: Who's there?! Get out — get OUT!
No, no, no — the door was locked!
Please — I'm not one of them, I'm not!
enter_key: Where did you get that key?!
That's my key — how have you got my key?
enter_again: You came back. Why did you come back?
scavenge_beg: Not that — please, that's all I've got!
I need that. I NEED that.
item_taken: How am I supposed to last now?
calm: …Just take what you need and go.
You're not going to hurt me, are you.

enter: Out. Now. Before I make you.
enter_key: Funny. I don't remember giving you a key.
enter_again: You've got some nerve coming back.
leave_demand: I won't say it again — OUT.
threaten: I've done worse to better than you.
Keep walking toward me. Go on.
scavenge_warn: That's mine. Touch it again and see.

enter: Whoa — easy. Easy. What do you want?
Hands where I can see them.
Door was locked for a reason, friend.
enter_key: Huh. Resourceful. I can respect that.
A key. Course you've got a key.
leave_demand: You browse, you buy. Or you leave.
trade_offer: Leave that. I'll give you my {give} for your {get}.
Tell you what — your {get}, my {give}. Fair?
Don't rummage. Swap me your {get} and the {give}'s yours.
trade_done: Pleasure. Now don't make it weird.
Deal. Don't spend it all at once.
trade_refused: Oh, so that's how it is.
turned_hostile: Right. No more Mr Nice Guy.
You want it that badly? Come and get it.
no_trade: You've got nothing I want. Hands off.
Empty pockets, empty hands. Leave it.

listen.scared: Someone's in there. Alive. Trying very hard to be quiet.
listen.hostile: Footsteps, pacing. Someone alive in there — muttering, angry.
listen.trader: A voice, low and steady. Someone alive in there, counting something.
